items.headline: FDA approves belzutifan-lenvatinib combination for advanced kidney cancer
items.summary: The FDA approved the combination of belzutifan and lenvatinib for adults with advanced kidney cancer whose disease had progressed after immunotherapy. In a phase three trial of nearly seven hundred fifty patients, the combination significantly outperformed the standard drug cabozantinib at slowing disease progression.
items.why_it_matters: It gives patients with hard-to-treat advanced kidney cancer a more effective next-line treatment option backed by large-scale trial evidence.
